title: Portrait and Visitor
author: E. M. Reyes
blurb: Theo Crane, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
